mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals easing monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 4.1% triggers negative returns as higher unemployment signals economic slowdown, reducing growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite UNRATE rising above 4.1% in the specified period.

mechanism_narrative: Both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) rising simultaneously indicate expansionary conditions, driving positive returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase simultaneously
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to be significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: High FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE signal monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in the tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the INDPRO index below 100 signals contractionary supply conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 100 in the contractionary regime.

mechanism_narrative: Rising UNRATE and PAYEMS together indicate labor market weakening, triggering negative returns over 20 days as investors anticipate slower growth.
candidate_trigger: both UNRATE and PAYEMS increase by >0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both labor indicators rise above thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high INDPRO coupled with low UNRATE signals an expansionary supply-demand balance, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to be significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in the expansionary regime.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 exceeding 24,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals robust demand, prompting positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 exceeds 24,000 in the specified period.
